final: SELECT AVG(avg_price) as avg_col2, AVG(diff_overall) as avg_col3, AVG(diff_filtered) as avg_col4 FROM (WITH step1 AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) as overall_avg FROM Products), step3 AS (SELECT step1.production_type_code, step1.avg_price, step1.avg_price - step2.overall_avg as diff_overall FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_price > step2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) as avg_of_avg FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.production_type_code, step3.avg_price, step3.diff_overall, step3.avg_price - step4.avg_of_avg as diff_filtered FROM step3, step4 WHERE step3.avg_price > step4.avg_of_avg) SELECT * FROM step5)
